prompt: Heavy rain flooded the park court, so the two teams (to play) the final match indoors.
explanation_ru: Обе команды сами сыграли финальный матч в зале (подлежащее выполняет действие), поэтому нужен активный залог: played.

prompt: Good news for your family dinner: the roast chicken has been cooked and the warm soup is ready.
answer: Good news for your family dinner: the roast chicken has been cooked and the warm soup is ready.
accepted_answers: Good news for your family dinner: the roast chicken has been cooked and the warm soup is ready.
explanation_ru: В предложении нет ошибки: форма Present Perfect Passive (has been cooked) использована правильно.

prompt: Catch the morning express train, and you ___ at the seaside station in time for lunch.
explanation_ru: Глагол arrive непереходный и никогда не ставится в пассивный залог (нельзя сказать will be arrived): will arrive.

prompt: My sister and I moved into our new flat over the weekend. Before the van arrived, all the heavy boxes (to carry) down to the entrance. On Sunday afternoon, we (to clean) every room from top to bottom. The whole place looks bright and welcoming.
explanation_ru: Коробки снесли вниз ещё до приезда фургона в прошлом (пассив: had been carried), а в воскресенье мы сами убрали комнаты (актив: cleaned).

prompt: We were delighted when the friendly couple next door (to invite) us to their summer garden party.
explanation_ru: Соседи сами пригласили нас на праздник (действие выполняет подлежащее the friendly couple), поэтому нужен актив: invited.

prompt: After checking my messages, I smiled because my travel visa (to approve) without any extra questions.
explanation_ru: Визу одобрили ещё до того, как я проверил почту в прошлом (smiled), поэтому используется Past Perfect Passive: had been approved.

prompt: Critics expect that the young director's new comedy film (to show) at major cinemas across Europe.
explanation_ru: Фильм покажут в кинотеатрах (действие направлено на film), поэтому после expect нужен Future Simple Passive: will be shown.

prompt: Situation: Ground workers are loading all the passenger bags onto the plane right now. Which sentence matches the situation?
options: All the passenger bags are being loaded onto the plane right now.
All the passenger bags are loading onto the plane right now.
All the passenger bags have been load onto the plane right now.
Ground workers are being loaded all the passenger bags onto the plane.
explanation_ru: Багаж загружают прямо сейчас (Present Continuous Passive: are being loaded); вариант are loading означает, что сумки загружают сами себя.

prompt: Our museum trip went wrong when a small accident ___ near the main entrance.
explanation_ru: Глагол happen непереходный (происшествие случилось само) и не образует пассивный залог: happened.

prompt: Every registered letter (can / to check) online once the clerk enters the order number.
explanation_ru: Письмо можно отследить (действие направлено на letter), поэтому после модального глагола can ставится be + V3: can be checked.

prompt: This sunny island village (to expect) to welcome thousands of summer visitors after the new ferry opens.
explanation_ru: В пассивной конструкции с глаголом ожидания используется форма is expected to: ожидается, что деревня примет туристов.

prompt: I ordered two winter jackets online, but my order has not been send from the shop yet.
answer: I ordered two winter jackets online, but my order has not been sent from the shop yet.
accepted_answers: I ordered two winter jackets online, but my order has not been sent from the shop yet.
I ordered two winter jackets online, but my order hasn't been sent from the shop yet.
explanation_ru: В форме Present Perfect Passive после has not been требуется третья форма глагола send: sent, а не send.

prompt: Your final essay (cannot / to accept) because you submitted it after the strict Friday deadline.
explanation_ru: Эссе не может быть принято (действие направлено на essay), поэтому после cannot нужна пассивная форма: cannot be accepted.

prompt: Before I left the doctor's office, the nurse (to measure) my blood pressure twice.
explanation_ru: Медсестра сама измерила давление (подлежащее the nurse выполняет действие), поэтому нужен активный залог: measured.

prompt: Nadia and I spend every sunny weekend working in our flower garden. Usually, the young apple trees (to water) in the cool evening. Yesterday, however, we (to plant) twelve bright yellow roses along the wooden fence. Everything looks lively and colourful.
explanation_ru: Регулярный полив деревьев передаётся через Present Simple Passive (are watered), а вчерашняя посадка роз нами самими — через Past Simple Active (planted).

prompt: When you join our local tennis club, you get full access to all courts. Every Monday morning, the net heights (to check) by the head coach. After that, you (can / to choose) any free court through our club website. Staff members are always happy to help.
explanation_ru: Высота сеток проверяется тренером (пассив: are checked), а выбрать свободный корт вы можете сами (актив: can choose).

prompt: Caleb sent a quick text message from the train station. His wallet (to find) by a cleaner near the ticket desk. Right now, he (to wait) at the office to collect it. He will meet us at the restaurant soon.
explanation_ru: Кошелёк нашёл уборщик (пассив: was found), а сам Калеб сейчас ждёт в бюро находок (актив: is waiting).

prompt: Remember that all birthday invitations must sent before Friday so guests can reply in time.
answer: Remember that all birthday invitations must be sent before Friday so guests can reply in time.
accepted_answers: Remember that all birthday invitations must be sent before Friday so guests can reply in time.
explanation_ru: В пассивном залоге после модального глагола must требуется be + V3: must be sent, а не must sent.

prompt: Simon looked at the menu and noticed that meal prices ___ twice since last summer.
explanation_ru: Глагол rise непереходный (цены выросли сами), а действие предшествовало моменту в прошлом (noticed) — нужен Past Perfect Active: had risen.

prompt: Tickets for the summer music festival sold out fast, so an extra show (to add) for Sunday.
explanation_ru: Дополнительное выступление добавлено в расписание, и это актуально сейчас — нужен Present Perfect Passive: has been added.

prompt: Thick fog covered the main road outside town early this morning. Several slow drivers (to stop) by traffic officers near the hill. Once the sun came out, the fog (to disappear) completely. Traffic is moving smoothly again.
explanation_ru: Водителей остановили инспекторы (пассив: were stopped), а туман рассеялся сам с непереходным глаголом disappear (актив: disappeared).

prompt: Mila works as a sales assistant in a busy city clothes shop. Before opening time, she (to arrange) the new shirts on the front tables. At the same time, old winter coats (to put) into boxes in the back room. The shop opens to customers at nine.
explanation_ru: Мила сама раскладывает новые рубашки (актив: arranges), а старые пальто убираются в коробки (пассив: are put).

prompt: Gavin goes to his local sports club three times a week. Before his evening run, the running machines (to clean) by the staff. Gavin always (to drink) plenty of water during his session. He feels full of energy afterwards.
explanation_ru: Тренажёры очищаются персоналом (пассив: are cleaned), а Гэвин сам пьёт воду во время тренировки (актив: drinks).

prompt: Nobody could enter the living room because the wooden floor ___ all afternoon.
explanation_ru: Пол не чинил сам себя — его ремонтировали в течение дня в прошлом (could enter), поэтому нужен Past Continuous Passive: was being repaired.

prompt: Talia had worked on the client report for hours, yet it (not / to send) before the office closed.
explanation_ru: Отчёт так и не был отправлен до закрытия офиса в прошлом (closed), поэтому используется Past Perfect Passive: had not been sent.

prompt: Before Friday evening, all the returned science books (to put) back on the main shelves.
explanation_ru: Действие завершится к указанному моменту в будущем (Before Friday evening), поэтому нужен Future Perfect Passive: will have been put.

prompt: Local residents are thrilled because a modern community library (to build) near the central square.
explanation_ru: Радость жителей сейчас вызвана тем, что библиотеку уже построили — нужен Present Perfect Passive: has been built.

prompt: We have (to prepare) our group presentation on world history since the beginning of the month.
explanation_ru: Мы сами готовим презентацию с начала месяца и продолжаем это делать — нужен Present Perfect Continuous Active: been preparing.

prompt: Sonia runs a cozy corner coffee shop near the station. Before opening time, fresh apple pies (to make) in the back kitchen. Sonia (to welcome) regular customers with a warm smile as they walk in. The smell of fresh coffee fills the street.
explanation_ru: Свежие пироги готовятся на кухне (пассив: are made), а Соня сама встречает постоянных посетителей (актив: welcomes).

prompt: When we arrived at the seaside hotel, our heavy bags (already / to carry) up to our room.
explanation_ru: Сумки подняли в номер ещё до нашего приезда в прошлом (arrived), поэтому требуется Past Perfect Passive: had already been carried.

prompt: Farmers watched the grey clouds closely because no rain ___ in the valley for six weeks.
explanation_ru: Глагол fall непереходный (дождь не шёл сам) и не ставится в пассив; до момента в прошлом (watched) нужен Past Perfect Active: had fallen.

prompt: Situation: Workers have planted fifty young trees along our quiet street this week. Which sentence matches the situation?
options: Fifty young trees have been planted along our quiet street this week.
Fifty young trees have planted along our quiet street this week.
Fifty young trees have been plant along our quiet street this week.
Workers have been planted fifty young trees along our quiet street.
explanation_ru: Деревья посажены вдоль улицы (Present Perfect Passive: have been planted); остальные варианты нарушают залог или форму глагола.

prompt: All fresh dairy products (must / to keep) in cold fridges so they stay safe for customers.
explanation_ru: Молочные продукты должны храниться в холодильниках (действие направлено на products), поэтому после must ставится be + V3: must be kept.

prompt: Felix needed a new bank card after he lost his wallet. On Monday morning, he (to fill) in a short form at the local branch. By Friday afternoon, the new card (to deliver) to his home address. He used it the next day.
explanation_ru: Феликс сам заполнил анкету в понедельник (актив: filled), а карту доставили к пятнице (пассив: had been delivered).

prompt: Many lost items end up at the central train station office. At the end of each shift, a station clerk (to record) each found bag in a large book. Unclaimed items (to keep) safely in a locked room for three months. Owners can visit the desk any day.
explanation_ru: Сотрудник сам записывает найденные сумки в журнал (актив: records), а невостребованные вещи хранятся в закрытой комнате (пассив: are kept).

prompt: Notice to all building residents: the main lift will stop working tomorrow morning. Important parts (to repair) by engineers throughout the day. During that time, the lift (not / to move) between floors. Normal service (to return) before six in the evening.
explanation_ru: Детали будут ремонтироваться инженерами (пассив: will be repaired), а лифт сам не будет двигаться и возобновит работу вечером (актив: will not move, will return).

prompt: Situation: Diana explained the new video app settings to her grandfather after dinner. Which sentence matches the situation?
options: The new video app settings were explained to Diana's grandfather after dinner.
Diana's grandfather was explained the new video app settings after dinner.
The new video app settings explained Diana's grandfather after dinner.
The new video app settings were explain to Diana's grandfather after dinner.
explanation_ru: В английском пассиве с глаголом explain подлежащим становится то, что объясняют (the new video app settings were explained), а не человек.

prompt: Although I answered every question clearly, another candidate (to choose) for the marketing role.
explanation_ru: На должность выбрали другого кандидата (действие направлено на another candidate) в прошлом (answered), поэтому нужен Past Simple Passive: was chosen.
